table.searchPlaceholder: Return ID, order ID, customer phone or name...

refund.open: Open Refunds to transfer the money

approve.title: Approve return request
approve.warning: The customer may now send the items back. The shipping instructions below are shown to the customer.

note.label: Shipping instructions
note.info: Optional. For example the address, the recipient, how to pack. The customer sees this.

reject.title: Reject return request
reject.warning: The request is rejected before the items arrive. The customer sees the reason below.

note.label: Reason
note.info: Required. The customer sees this reason.

receive.title: Confirm the items arrived
receive.warning: Check the items, then enter how many of each line you accept. The refund amount is computed from this and a refund is created in Refunds.

shipping.label: Also refund the shipping fee
shipping.info: The shipping fee of an order can be refunded only once.

note.label: Note for the customer
note.info: Optional. Replaces the earlier reply if there is one. The customer sees this.

errors.invalid: Quantities must be whole numbers from 0 up to what the customer asked to return
errors.allZero: Accept at least one item. If nothing is acceptable, use "Reject" instead.

pending.title: {count, plural, one {# return request to review} other {# return requests to review}}
pending.includes: Return requests customers just sent that are not yet approved or rejected.
pending.excludes: Approved requests waiting for the customer to ship the items are not counted. When the items arrive, open that request and click "Received".
pending.how: Read the customer's reason and note, then approve (with shipping instructions) or reject (with a reason).
pending.approvedLine: Approved requests waiting for the items
